name: Nebula Overlay Network Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source encrypted peer-to-peer overlay network using certificate-based identity, built-in firewall rules and self-managed lighthouse discovery; no vendor-imposed node or traffic quota in the software.
watch_out: You must provision and maintain lighthouse/peer nodes, certificates, networking, routing and any relay infrastructure. Cloud servers, egress, mobile platform dependencies and operations can cost extra; no hosted free VPN service or managed SLA is included.
